---
title: Run asynchronous tasks
description: Preserve ownership, payment admission, and retry safety for long-running fulfillment.
icon: ListChecks
status: next
verifiedVersion: 0.6.3

Install `a2a()` to expose owned task routes backed by the canonical entrypoint
registry. A task reservation is created only after authorization succeeds.

```ts
const runtime = await createAgent(meta)
  .use(payments({ config }))
  .use(a2a({ taskStore }))
  .use(http())
  .build();
```

Task state follows an owned state machine: submitted, working, completed,
failed, or canceled. Store task records durably in production and use leases so
two workers cannot fulfill the same task concurrently.

Payment admission does not make fulfillment infallible. Define what happens
when work fails after verification and before settlement, and never create a
second business task merely because a client retried an HTTP request. Use a
stable idempotency key and return the existing task identity.

See [A2A](/docs/protocols/a2a) for discovery and client operations.
